rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for bodily leanness and lean meat.

example.english: I quite like eating lean meat.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gei2 zung1 ji3 sik6 sau3 juk6

rows.note: Use 挨 for physically leaning against something for support or comfort.

example.english: I lean against the table while copying notes.
example.jyutping: ngo5 aai1 zyu6 zoeng1 toi2 caau1 je5

rows.note: Use 傾 for the all-purpose physical sense of tilting or leaning away from vertical.

example.english: The table has started to lean to the right.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 hoeng3 jau6 bin1 king1 zo2

rows.note: Use 傾向 when someone is leaning toward an opinion, choice, or course of action.

example.english: I lean toward supporting this plan.
example.jyutping: ngo5 king1 hoeng3 zi1 ci4 ni1 go3 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use this when a budget, supply, or other resource has little to spare.

example.english: This month’s budget is lean, so we can’t spend money carelessly.
example.traditional: 今個月預算有限，唔可以亂使錢。
example.jyutping: gam1 go3 jyut6 jyu6 syun3 jau5 haan6 m4 ho2 ji5 lyun6 sai2 cin2

rows.note: Use this for a streamlined, waste-cutting organisation, process, or management style.

example.english: The company adopted lean management and saved a lot of costs.
example.traditional: 公司推行精簡管理，慳返好多成本。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 teoi1 hang4 zing1 gaan2 gun2 lei5 haan1 faan1 hou2 do1 sing4 bun2

rows.note: Use this when a material has a low amount or concentration of the desired substance.

example.english: This milk is lean, so it feels less heavy to drink.
example.traditional: 呢款牛奶嘅脂肪含量低，飲落冇咁滯。
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 ngau4 naai5 ge3 zi1 fong1 ham4 loeng6 dai1 jam2 lok6 mou5 gam3 zai6
